rewrite: Human adjudication is a reference procedure, not infallible ground truth. Translation artifacts, reviewer overlap, familiarity with paired variants, and exclusion of unresolved items can affect the sample and its labels. Exclusion counts and reasons will accompany the results. Model drift and prior exposure to reused material are additional threats. The study will prefer reusable public passages alongside original passages that are non-sensitive and will record provenance and licensing before data collection.
note: meaning changed: "Reusable public or original non-sensitive passages will be preferred" -> "The study will prefer reusable public passages alongside original passages that are non-sensitive". The change from "or" to "alongside" changes the meaning: "or" means that either of the two items is sufficient, whereas "alongisde" suggests that both items are required.
